projects.title: Sri Venkataramana Temple
projects.description: A complete reconstruction of the main sanctum and outer prakara in traditional Kerala-Tulunadu style, using hand-cut granite and a copper-clad roof over the garbhagriha. The work included fresh consecration (punah prathishta) on completion.

awards.title: Best Heritage Restoration
awards.note: Recognised for the restoration of Sri Venkataramana Temple, Kaup.

testimonials.name: Suresh Kamath
testimonials.quote: Ramanna Acharya and his team rebuilt our village temple with so much care and devotion. The craftsmanship reminded elders of temples from a hundred years ago.

services.name: Temple Construction
services.blurb: New temple construction following agama shastra, from foundation to kalasha.

services.name: Pond & Pushkarini Building
services.blurb: Stepped temple ponds built with traditional stonework and proper water flow.

services.name: Renovation & Restoration
services.blurb: Careful restoration of old temples, preserving original design wherever possible.

about.body:
Shri Builders has been building and restoring temples and ponds across coastal Karnataka for three generations.
We specialise in traditional agama-shastra-compliant temple construction, gopura towers, and stepped pushkarinis, using hand-cut stone and time-tested methods passed down through our family.
Every project is carried out with the involvement of local priests and committees, from bhoomi puja to final consecration.
